periods.summary: Jounosaki appears with Moroboshi and Asagi at the banquet as part of the previous year's top three. He criticizes Tatara's crude behavior and later is mentioned as winning C-block's third first-round match by sending his opponent out of bounds, immediately before Ikki versus Moroboshi begins.

key_events.summary: Joins Moroboshi in pressuring Tatara to back down.
Wins the C-block third match before Ikki's match.

periods.time: Night after first round through C-block second-round match
periods.label: 天眼的二十三手被斩断

status.current: second-round opponent of Ikki; loses consciousness immediately at match start after Ittou Rasetsu

personality.summary: Cerebral and elegant, treating duels as intellectual games to be solved before they begin, with an eccentric habit of over-investigating opponents' bodies and preferences.

abilities_owned: spatial transfer within about fifty meters

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Second-round opponent whose body and habits he studies; predicts a 23-move win that Ikki ruins instantly.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Investigated as a potential Hagun representative and correctly gives him preferred canned coffee in the bathhouse.
relationships.momiji: Loved girl mentioned when denying that his body-touching interest is sexual.
relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Friend and schoolmate; Moroboshi visits before the match, teasing and warning him not to underestimate Ikki.

periods.summary: Byakuya encounters Ikki in the bathhouse and demonstrates White Hand by teleporting drinks into Ikki's and Alice's hands after reading their preferences. Ikki explains that Byakuya's strength is not only forced relocation of objects within range after locking them, but an overwhelming ability to gather data and infer a person's concept before the match. In the preparation room Byakuya frames duels as intellectual chess and predicts that Ikki, needing to save Ittou Shura for Sara, will fight without his trump card and lose on the twenty-third move. His entire scenario collapses when Ikki chooses the supposedly impossible opening: immediate Ittou Rasetsu. Byakuya's memory cuts off at the start signal, implying instant defeat before his planned battle can begin.

key_events.summary: Meets Ikki, studies his body, and demonstrates White Hand with drink teleportation.
Has his predicted twenty-three-move battle cut short by Ikki's immediate Ittou Rasetsu.

periods.label: 天眼被一刀罗刹抢先击倒

status.condition: knocked unconscious at the starting line

personality.summary: A calculating observer whose pre-battle reading is strong enough to frighten Ikki into spending his trump card.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Opponent; Byakuya's prediction would catch Ikki by the twenty-third move unless Ikki breaks the board immediately.

periods.summary: Byakuya's second-round match with Ikki ends instantly when Ikki opens with Ittou Rasetsu plus the sword method learned from Edelweiss. Publicly it looks like a one-sided record victory over last year's runner-up, but Ikki privately recognizes that Byakuya was dangerous enough that ordinary tactics would have led to capture by the twenty-third move. Byakuya's strength forces Ikki to spend his once-per-day trump card before facing Sara later that evening.

key_events.summary: Is defeated before moving, but his threat level shapes Ikki's later disadvantage.

periods.label: 协助一辉的天眼

status.condition: defeated quickly in spar but sharp as observer

relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Bukyou teammate who brings him to Ikki's training.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former tournament opponent; assists his final preparation.

periods.summary: Byakuya joins Moroboshi's group of defeated rivals who help Ikki tune himself before the final. He is among the first beaten in the gauntlet, but later observes the final and explains to Shizuku that Stella's self-stabbing motion against Ouma was a staged tell meant to deceive Ikki in the final.

key_events.summary: Analyzes Stella's cross-match Dragon Spirit deception.

periods.label: 天眼对白诸星的杀手本能

status.current: interviewed by Bukyoku newspaper club after special conscription duty

relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Classmate and rival whom Byakuya considers more frightening than Ikki in some respects.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Opponent who beat him quickly under unusual tournament conditions.
relationships.momiji-asagi: One of Bukyoku's three student stars, mentioned as a more popular feature subject.

periods.summary: Byakuya is interviewed by Bukyoku newspaper-club president Yagokoro after Moroboshi unexpectedly goes to Tokyo. He says Ikki is strong, but Moroboshi is more frightening to him because Byakuya has fought Moroboshi countless times, knows him better than anyone, and still has never won. He describes Moroboshi's ability to exceed data and prediction at decisive moments as Killer Instinct, an observation that contextualizes Moroboshi's final aura against Kuraudo.

key_events.summary: Explains why Moroboshi can overturn even well-planned strategies.

periods.time: Emergency summons from Bukyoku Academy to Fukuoka
periods.label: 天眼的紧急传送
periods.affiliation: Bukyoku Academy; International Mage-Knight League emergency response

status.current: supports Wakaba House and refugee evacuation after teleporting Moroboshi to Kyushu

relationships.yudai-moroboshi: Teleports Moroboshi from Osaka to Kyushu under League summons.
relationships.kanata-tokutomiya: Meets her after arriving and remains near evacuation operations.
relationships.toka-todo: Indirectly helps rescue her by delivering Moroboshi.

periods.summary: Jounosaki is specially summoned along with Moroboshi because his Teleport can rapidly deliver Moroboshi to Fukuoka. He transports them from Osaka to Kyushu in roughly five minutes, meets Kanata, and then stays with the evacuation side because no one is better at escaping and moving people than he is. His role is logistical but crucial: without his teleportation Moroboshi would not arrive in time to save Toka and Misogi from Tendo's first close-range assault.

key_events.summary: Enables Moroboshi's timely arrival by teleporting him from Bukyoku to Kyushu.
